book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: بأي لغة، في حرف بيتكرر أكتر من غيره.
sentences.en: Holmes said: in any language, one letter recurs more than the others.
In English, it is the letter E.

sentences.ar: عد الرجال ولقى واحد بيتكرر كتير.
sentences.en: He counted the figures and found one recurring often.

sentences.ar: وبعدين لقى كلمة قصيرة بأربع حروف بينهم E مرتين.
sentences.en: And then he found a short four-letter word with E twice in it.
It was the client’s wife’s name.

sentences.ar: ومن هون، فك الباقي حرف حرف.
sentences.en: And from there, he unravelled the rest letter by letter.
The last message read: prepare to die.
